description.zh: 应用ID。通过控制台创建和查询，仅支持传单个ID。
description.en: Application ID. Find or create this ID in the console. You can specify only one ID.

descriptions.zh:
### QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为10次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
### QPS limit

The per-user query-per-second (QPS) limit for this API is 10 calls per second. Exceeding this limit triggers rate limiting, which may affect your business operations. Call this API only when necessary.
